summary: RWA compliance as attachable modules plus tokenized-asset lifecycle with a rebuildable off-chain mirror: compliance split into separable identity-claims, claim-topics/issuers, rules, and document-manager checks; identity as issuer-attested claims on topics re-checked at transfer time; nonce-based signature invalidation naming network and issuer; never store personal data in shared records (opaque identifier + verification status only); lifecycle as explicit named states (register, verify, mint, redeem) with one event per transition; on-chain record as source of truth with the off-chain table a derived rebuildable mirror; exact event-index discipline; off-chain-assigned UID written back on-chain as metadata; simulation before broadcast; dual triggers (event log + HTTP) for one lifecycle; plus multi-tier commission rule shapes (volume-derived tiers recomputed per sale, upline paid only the tier gap, shared-sale split with single-side volume credit, reduced flat rate for inactive participants, distinct transaction types). Patterns from OpenZeppelin stellar-contracts (MIT) and Chainlink cre-templates (MIT); rt-commission-dashboard (Proprietary) contributes ideas only.
